title: Project F MES Blind Test - Miss Diagnosis (漏检诊断)
diagnosis_summary: 90%+ experiments were blocked because the MES domain requires complex multi-entity fixtures (Work Orders with BOMs, Routings, Reservations in specific states) that the current auto-fixture system cannot materialize. Path placeholders like {id} in API routes could not be resolved without pre-existing entities.

BLOCKED_MISSING_BINDING.description: Experiments requiring entity IDs in path parameters could not resolve placeholders

BLOCKED_MISSING_OBSERVER.description: State machine experiments requiring entities in specific states (e.g., COMPLETED, IN_PRODUCTION)

NOT_ATTEMPTED.description: Experiment not generated for this bug pattern

ACTOR_AUTHORIZATION.diagnosis: Actor matrix was partially resolved but experiments targeting field-level authorization (unit_cost) and cross-factory scope were blocked by missing entity bindings
ACTOR_AUTHORIZATION.root_gap: Field-level permission experiments require existing entity to modify; entity creation itself requires fixture chain
ACTOR_AUTHORIZATION.improvement: Add seed entity bootstrap for actor authorization tests

SCOPE_ISOLATION.diagnosis: List endpoint scope experiments were planned but not executed due to missing observer bindings for multi-org verification
SCOPE_ISOLATION.root_gap: Scope isolation tests need entities from multiple orgs pre-seeded
SCOPE_ISOLATION.improvement: Auto-seed multi-org entities for scope tests

STATE_TRANSITION.diagnosis: State machine experiments require entities in specific states (IN_PRODUCTION, COMPLETED, CONFIRMED). Cannot create entity and advance state in single fixture step.
STATE_TRANSITION.root_gap: Multi-step fixture setup not supported: create WO → release → start → complete
STATE_TRANSITION.improvement: Implement state advancement chain in fixture materializer

CROSS_ENTITY_PRECONDITION.diagnosis: Precondition validation tests require related entities (BOM, Routing, Reservations, Inspections) to exist in specific states
CROSS_ENTITY_PRECONDITION.root_gap: Cross-entity dependency chain too deep for auto-fixture

CROSS_ENTITY_CONSISTENCY.diagnosis: Consistency checks require multiple related entities with aggregate state verification
CROSS_ENTITY_CONSISTENCY.root_gap: Aggregate state verification across entity boundaries not supported
CROSS_ENTITY_CONSISTENCY.improvement: Add aggregate fixture with cross-entity state coordination

IDEMPOTENCY.diagnosis: Duplicate detection tests require successful first creation, then retry. First creation blocked by fixture requirements.
IDEMPOTENCY.root_gap: Idempotency tests need successful baseline operation first

CONSERVATION.diagnosis: Conservation/quantity tests require entities with specific numeric states (reserved_quantity, issued_quantity, sample_size)

COMPENSATION.diagnosis: Compensation tests require action + rollback verification. Action blocked by missing entity binding.
COMPENSATION.root_gap: Compensation chain (action → verify side effects) requires multi-step execution

TEMPORAL.diagnosis: Temporal validation tests require entities with date fields in specific relationships (past expiry, confirmed plan dates)

CONCURRENCY.diagnosis: Concurrency/version tests require existing entity with version field. Entity creation blocked.

BATCH_OPERATION.diagnosis: Batch operation tests require multiple entities in mixed states (some valid, some invalid for the operation)
BATCH_OPERATION.improvement: Add batch fixture with heterogeneous entity states

fixture_materialization.description: Cannot create MES domain entities through API due to complex interdependencies

state_advancement.description: Cannot advance entities through state machine transitions for state-dependent tests
state_advancement.impact: Blocks all STATE_TRANSITION and related mechanism tests

path_resolution.description: Cannot resolve {id} path placeholders without discoverable entity IDs
path_resolution.impact: Blocks all operations on specific entity instances
path_resolution.improvement_needed: Entity discovery via list endpoints or seed data injection

multi_step_fixtures.description: Cannot execute multi-step fixture setup (create A → create B referencing A → advance A state)

recommendations_priority: P0: Implement entity discovery - call GET list endpoints to obtain existing entity IDs
P0: Add seed data bootstrap - pre-populate SUT with entities in various states
P1: Implement state advancement chain - create entity then advance through transitions
P1: Add cross-entity fixture graph - resolve entity dependencies automatically
P2: Add batch fixture with mixed entity states
conclusion: The miss pattern is systemic, not random. All 31 missed bugs share a common root cause: the inability to materialize complex MES domain fixtures. This is a capability gap in fixture management, not in bug detection logic. The single detected bug (BUG-MES-006) was found because it only required a POST request with actor tokens - no pre-existing entity needed. Future MES-domain tests require fixture infrastructure investment.
